entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hello, Alex. I... I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely help you with the return process. Could you provide me with your order number, please?
Yes, it's VF887-21. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I saved up for these. It just feels awful that they didn't work out.

I understand completely. Let me just pull that up. Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Level cycling shoes, delivered 11 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically was the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

It's the fit. My very first ride in them, I got terrible blisters right on the ball of my foot. I think it's from how my foot sits over the cleats. They're just not right for me, and I really need to get a refund. I was counting on that money if they didn't work.
Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and I'm very sorry that happened. Thank you for explaining that. Let me just review the policy for these cycling shoes.
Okay, I've confirmed it. Since you received the item less than 90 days ago, you are well within the return window for a full refund. We can absolutely get that started for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. Thank you so much, Alex. I was so worried I was just going to be stuck with them.

Not at all. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll process your refund. Does that sound good?
Yes, that sounds perfect. Thank you again. You've really helped me out today.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
